name: Whirlpool MVW6200 Inlet Valve Coil Resistance (J8)
purpose: Solenoid coils on J8 valve harness — common J8-1 (AGND) to valve pin.
failureModes: Open coil — no fill on that leg (F8E1 / LF)
Tens of ohms outside range — replace valve assembly
testingTips: W11416395 TEST #2 — Fabric Softener J8-1&6, Hot J8-1&5, Cold J8-1&3
Live valve test via Service Test Mode water valve sequence

name: Whirlpool MVW6200 PSC Motor Winding Resistance (J6)
purpose: PSC motor windings at ACU J6 — CW J6-4↔6 and CCW J6-1↔6.
failureModes: Open winding — F7E6 motor circuit open
Good ohms but hum/no start — check run capacitor
testingTips: W11416395 TEST #3b — also measure at motor connector pins 3&2 (CW) and 4&2 (CCW)
Verify basket turns freely before condemning motor

name: Whirlpool MVW6200 Shifter Coil Resistance (J6)
purpose: Shifter motor coil at J6-2 and J6-6.
failureModes: Open — F7E3 basket engaged during wash
testingTips: Verify splutch cam moves freely before ohms
Lid must be closed for shifter service test

name: Whirlpool MVW6200 Drain Pump Resistance (J6)
purpose: Drain pump winding at J6-3 (DRAIN_PUMP) and J6-6 (NEUTRAL).
failureModes: Good ohms but no run — ACU relay or obstruction
testingTips: W11416395 TEST #7 — verify at pump terminals after harness check

name: Whirlpool MVW6200 Lid Lock Solenoid Resistance (J4)
purpose: Lid lock solenoid at J4-2 and J4-3.
failureModes: Open solenoid — F5E3 unlock / lock failures
Switch state mismatch — replace lid lock mechanism
testingTips: W11416395 TEST #8 — also verify lock switch J4-1↔2 and lid switch J4-2↔1
Run Lid Lock test in Service Load Control before bench ohms

name: Whirlpool MVW6200 Inlet Thermistor Resistance (J8)
purpose: Inlet water thermistor at J8-8 (NTC 1) and J8-9 (AGND). ~50 kΩ at 77°F (25°C) per OEM table.
failureModes: Open or short — F3E3 inlet water temperature fault
Out of range — replace valve assembly (thermistor integral)
testingTips: Compare to OEM R/T table in TEST #5
Use Sensor Feedback Inlet Thermistor test before bench ohms

name: Whirlpool MVW6200 ACU +12 VDC Supply (J5)
purpose: +12 VDC at J5-1 vs J5-4 (Circuit Gnd) with J5 disconnected from HMI load check.
failureModes: +12 VDC present but LED not flashing — ACU micro failure
testingTips: W11416395 TEST #1 — remove J5 to isolate HMI load on DC supply
Diagnostic LED flashing = +5 VDC present and micro operating (per manual)
